the transgenic Trichodema koningi strain Mc4 with chBDs from the bitter melon exhibited increased virulence and antifungal activity.

the chit42 genes with different chBDs were overexpressed in Trichoderma, and Mc4, a hybrid chit42 transformant with bitter melon chBD, displayed the highest chit42 expression, chitinase activity, and antifungal activity, and the highest virulence to corn borer larvae.
the chit42 chitinase gene from Metarhiziun anisoplia e was expressed in Trichoderma, and that chit42 chitnase fused to chBD from bitter melon showed the highest activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new biopesticide with high virulence against corn borer and other fungal diseases.
the construction of chBD-fused Trichoderma strains with enhanced virulence to the Asian corn borers.
the construction of transgenic Trichoerma with enhanced antifungal activity and insecticidal effect by overexpressing a heterologous chitinase gene fused with chBDs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Mc4, a chit42 chitinase fusion with chBDs derived bitter melon, is a promising candidate for biocontrol agents.

the chit42 chitinase gene from Metarhiza nisopliae was successfully expressed in the Trichoderma strains and the fusion of chit42 gene to chBDs enhanced the chitinase activity and virulence of the Trichoder ma strains.
the chit42 fusion protein with plant chBD exhibited the highest chitin-binding and hydrolyzing activities, and it was the most effective against corn borer larvae.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the chBD of bitter melon chit42 gene can enhance the chitinase activity of chit42 gene in Trichoderma, which in turn increases the virulence of the transformants against the corn borer and enhances the antifungal activity of the transformants.

the chit42 genes from different species can be used to construct Trichoderma chit42 transformants with different chBDs, and the chBDs of bitter melon chitinase have the strongest chitin-binding ability.
chit42 gene overexpression with the addition of chBDs from different sources could improve the antifungal and insecticidal activity of Trichoderma.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the chit42 genes fused with chBDs from different origins can be overexpressed in T. koningii, and the chit42-Mc4 hybrid chitinase can significantly improve the virulence of T. koningi strains.
chBDs derived not only from plants but also from insects and bacteria are effective in enhancing the chitinase activity and virulence of Trichoderma strains.
the hybrid chitinase with chBDs from plants, bacteria, and insects can increase chitinase activities and virulence of Trichoderma to the corn borer and other plant pathogens.
